name: process_manage
description: Poll, wait on, send input to, or kill terminal(background=true) processes started in this session. list: all processes with status. poll: status + new output since the last poll. log: full output, paged (rolling buffer of recent output). wait: block until exit or timeout (partial output on timeout). write vs submit: submit appends Enter — use it to answer prompts; write sends raw text, no newline. close: EOF stdin. kill: terminate the process and its children.

session_id.description: From terminal background output; any unique prefix works ('4dae' for proc_4dae56ca81f6). Required except for 'list'.
